purpose: Bind three distinct highlight roles into one regenerative canary: explanation, contradiction/open-question, and recovery/failure evidence.

assets.asset: CoCivia teaching / inquiry / learnback / transparent-attention weave
assets.source_basis: Existing highlightable-asset freshness audit identifies this as a human-facing civic / learning product story candidate.
assets.purpose: Explain a concrete CoCivium pattern through inquiry, learnback, and contestable attention rather than abstract ontology.
assets.challenge_path: Ask whether the teaching / attention pattern improves comprehension, preserves contestability, and avoids authority inflation.
assets.successor_condition: A newer source-bound explanation measurably improves receiver fit without changing the underlying claim/evidence state.

assets.source_basis: The bounded freshness audit states that no completed July 26 primary CoHP source selection or semantic diff is proven and that CoHP is likely stale relative to material deltas.
assets.purpose: Keep the unresolved source/currentness problem visible so newer interpretations do not silently overwrite uncertain lineage.
assets.challenge_path: Produce exact source discovery, source selection rationale, and append-only semantic diff; contradiction remains open until evidence closes it.
assets.successor_condition: Replace the contradiction highlight with a source-bound currentness / lineage highlight once exact evidence resolves the ambiguity.

assets.source_basis: Existing audit records 405 legacy items, 78 current items, zero JSON parse failures, readproof hints, and one exact cross-inbox duplicate content set; it explicitly classifies this as custody/backlog evidence, not owner acceptance.
assets.purpose: Show why legacy/current reconciliation is required before source comprehensiveness, currentness, or acceptance may be inferred.
assets.failure_side: Fragmented legacy/current custody can hide stale, duplicate, or unacknowledged state.
assets.recovery_side: Read-only reconciliation plus dedupe/currentness mapping improves recoverability without implying adoption.
assets.challenge_path: Test whether future reconciliation runs preserve exact counts, provenance, duplicate sets, receiver-state distinctions, and nonclaims.
assets.successor_condition: A newer reconciliation with stronger receiver-bound proof and independent failure-domain recovery supersedes this highlight.

canary_test.method: No publication. Render each asset as a compact highlight card with source, receiver, purpose, gate, challenge, expiry, and return fields; compare receiver usefulness and ambiguity.
pass_if: no highlight changes truth or authority state
fail_if: stale asset remains prominent without requalification
recovery evidence is marketed as adoption
reader attention is counted as evidence
